title: The derived unit transported to a prescribed resolution is the augmented comparison
statement: Let A,B be abelian with bounded-below derived categories, A having enough injectives. Let F:A→B be additive and X in A. Let I resolve X and J resolve FX [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For φ:J→F(I) satisfying ι_J^0 φ^0=F(ι_I^0), let f be its extension by zero. Then u_F(X) followed by canonicalResolutionDerivedIso F I equals resolutionAugmentationIso J followed by Q(f) [def-pc-canonical-resolution-derived-iso], where u_F(X)=rightDerivedPlusSingleUnit X [lem-sbc-right-derived-single-unit-homology-comparison]. This equality is in D⁺(B), before applying any further functor or homology; no left exactness of F is required.

proof.text: Expand the derived single unit and resolutionDerivedIso. Naturality of the derived unit along the augmentation of I cancels the unit against its inverse on the complex of injectives I. The single and quotient source isomorphisms cancel by localization naturality.

After composing the map/extension isomorphism, the remaining complex morphism is the single-map comparison inverse followed by F(ι_I) and the map/extension comparison. The augmentation of J followed by extendMap φ equals this: from_single_hom_ext reduces to degree zero, where extendMap_f and ι'_f_zero cancel the extension isomorphisms and hφ gives the equality. In all other degrees the source is zero.

Apply faithful derived Plus inclusion, quotientCompQhIso naturality and localization functoriality to the complex equality. The singleFunctorIsoCompQ and quotient comparisons are identity maps; this gives the stated derived-category equality.

theorem resolutionDerivedSingleUnit_augmentation
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [EnoughInjectives A]
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory A] [HasDerivedCategory B]
    (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive]
    (X : A) (I : InjectiveResolution X) (J : InjectiveResolution (F.obj X))
    (φ : J.cocomplex ⟶ (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
    (hφ : J.ι.f 0 ≫ φ.f 0 = F.map (I.ι.f 0)) :
    let K := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let L : CochainComplex.Plus B :=
      ⟨K.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat, 0, inferInstance⟩
    let f : (⟨J.cochainComplex, 0, inferInstance⟩ : CochainComplex.Plus B) ⟶ L :=
      ObjectProperty.homMk (HomologicalComplex.extendMap φ ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
    F.rightDerivedPlusSingleUnit X ≫ (canonicalResolutionDerivedIso F I).hom =
      (resolutionAugmentationIso J).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.map f
